item.title: ABC News: Bomb threats spread to European newsrooms after wave of passenger jet scares
item.description: Spain's foreign minister said the continent appeared to be facing "hybrid aggression and a form of psychological warfare".

item.title: ABC News: Three detainees scale Banksia Hill Detention Centre roof
item.description: Aerial footage shows damage to parts of the Banksia Hill Detention Centre, including to windows and an air conditioning unit, after three detainees climbed to the roof at Perth's youth detention facility.

item.title: ABC News: Threatening, sexist messages scrawled on balloons left at MP's office
item.description: Threatening, sexist and abusive messages scrawled on balloons have been left outside the suburban electorate office of South Australian government MP Jayne Stinson, with police confirming they are investigating the matter.

item.title: ABC News: Alleged stalker who threatened to kill jockey Michelle Payne denied bail
item.description: A 51-year-old man who allegedly sent a series of violent threats and sexualised slurs at the first woman to win the Melbourne Cup has been denied bail.

item.title: ABC News: Ex-partner of disgraced author Craig Silvey speaks of 'great betrayal'
item.description: The former partner of disgraced author Craig Silvey makes her first public statement since he was sentenced on child exploitation charges, describing his actions as a "great betrayal".

item.title: ABC News: Woman rescues baby koala from grips of python in Brisbane
item.description: The woman was walking through a nature reserve in Brisbane when she came across the dramatic scene.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Paul Gallen takes on Nelson Asofa-Solomona in boxing grudge match
item.description: Paul Gallen steps back into the ring to take on Nelson Asofa-Solomona in a grudge match between the two former NRL stars in Sydney. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: 18yo, teenagers arrested over Calder Highway pursuit
item.description: An 18-year-old described as the ringleader behind a series of alleged youth crimes in Victoria's north-west is remanded in custody.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Kumanjayi Little Baby's father jailed for more than three years for DV
item.description: The father of five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby has been handed a jail sentence of more than three years for aggravated assault, for offences committed against the girl's mother.

item.title: ABC News: Australians urged to reconsider fast fashion as workers fight for better pay
item.description: The action, in which garment workers have clashed with police, is a culmination of the apparel industry's global supply chains, which human right experts say result in poor working conditions.

item.title: ABC News: Drug driver jailed for crash that resulted in premature baby death
item.description: Andrew Dean Robson, 35, has been sentenced to seven years in jail for a car crash that resulted in a pregnant teenager losing her baby.

item.title: ABC News: Alleged kitchen knife murderer Conor O’Neill denied bail
item.description: A 40-year-old man who allegedly stabbed his 47-year-old partner while the pair were driving through a Northern Territory suburb has been refused bail.

item.title: ABC News: 'Multitude of factors' behind firing of chef who refused pineapple on pizza
item.description: Brisbane restaurant manager Elliot Ingram says there were a number of reasons behind the firing of a chef who refused to put pineapple on a customer's pizza.

item.title: ABC News: Young victim of hotel fall died in 'tragic' accident, parents say
item.description: The grief-stricken parents of Natasha Lawton, who died in a fall at a Hindley Street hotel in Adelaide's CBD, have described their daughter as someone who "loved life and lived every minute".

item.title: ABC News: Data centre plan could bring water into Queensland, minister says
item.description: Queensland Water Minister Ann Leahy says rapid industrial growth in the Western Downs could help drive private investment in major water infrastructure projects, including the long-discussed Nathan Dam project.

item.title: ABC News: Multimillionaire friend of Sam Wood offered surety in his bail application
item.description: Alongside listing the home as a place Mr Wood could live, the person also offered $1 million in cash.
